metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 level higher in February 2020 than in February 2019 within a 50km radius of (40.923221, 104.238631)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point (40.923221, 104.238631) with 50km buffer - Time: February 2019 vs February 2020 - Collection: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_AER_AI for aerosol products, or potentially other air quality datasets - Actually, for PM2.5, I should use specific air quality datasets. Let me check available options: * OpenAQ data might be point-based * CAMS (Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service) has PM2.5: ECMWF/CAMS/NRT - Best option: ECMWF/CAMS/NRT has particulate_matter_d_less_than_25_um_surface 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for atmospheric composition data - Just need to compute mean PM2.5 over the region for both time periods 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection size for both periods - Check pixel counts after reduction - Validate that PM2.5 values are in reasonable range (typically 0-500 μg/m³) - Compare 2020 vs 2019 values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([104.238631, 40.923221]); const aoi = center.buffer(50000); // 50km radius const date2019_start = '2019-02-01'; const date2019_end = '2019-03-01'; const date2020_start = '2020-02-01'; const date2020_end = '2020-03-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const pm25Band = 'particulate_matter_d_less_than_25_um_surface'; const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/CAMS/NRT') .select(pm25Band) .filterDate(date2019_start, date2019_end) .filterBounds(aoi); const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/CAMS/NRT') .select(pm25Band) .filterDate(date2020_start, date2020_end) .filterBounds(aoi); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log('No data found for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean PM2.5 for each period const mean2019 = col2019.mean(); const mean2020 = col2020.mean(); // 4. Reduction with pixel count validation const stats2019 = mean2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: aoi, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: aoi, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pm2019 = stats2019.get(pm25Band + '_mean').getInfo(); const count2019 = stats2019.get(pm25Band + '_count').getInfo(); const pm2020 = stats2020.get(pm25Band + '_mean').getInfo(); const count2020 = stats2020.get(pm25Band + '_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 PM2.5: ${pm2019}, Pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 PM2.5: ${pm2020}, Pixels: ${count2020}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (pm2019 === null || pm2020 === null || isNaN(pm2019) || isNaN(pm2020) || pm2019 < 0 || pm2020 < 0 || pm2019 > 1000 || pm2020 > 1000) { console.log('Invalid PM2.5 values calculated.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Comparison: Feb 2020 (${pm2020.toFixed(2)}) vs Feb 2019 (${pm2019.toFixed(2)})`); if (pm2020 > pm2019) { console.log('PM2.5 was higher in February 2020.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('PM2.5 was not higher in February 2020.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
